description: Page navigated between AX read and click. Re-read tree.

antiPatterns.reason: Old tree was for the repo page; we're now on /login. Re-read.

expected.successRubric: After a click that navigated, the entire ref_id space resets. Re-read.

content:
The previous attempt to click the sign-in link failed because the reference ID was not found in the accessibility tree. This could be due to the page being in a different state or the accessibility tree not being updated correctly.

Let me try a different approach. I'll use the `click` tool with the visible text "Sign in" instead of relying on the reference ID. This should be more reliable.</think><|tool_call_start|>[click(text='Sign in')]<|tool_call_end|>
